tools.name: slack_create_channel
tools.description: Creates a new channel in the Slack workspace

name.description: Channel name (lowercase, no spaces, max 80 chars)

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: Lists all channels in the Slack workspace

types.description: Comma-separated list of channel types (public_channel, private_channel)

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return (max 1000)

tools.name: slack_list_users
tools.description: Lists all users in the Slack workspace

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return (max 1000)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

tools.name: slack_post_file
tools.description: Uploads and shares a file to a Slack channel

channels.description: Comma-separated list of channel IDs to share file to

initial_comment.description: Initial comment to add with the file

tools.name: slack_send_message
tools.description: Sends a message to a Slack channel or direct message

channel.description: Channel ID or name (e.g., "#general") to send message to

text.description: Message text content (supports Slack markdown formatting)

blocks.description: Optional Block Kit blocks for rich message formatting

thread_ts.description: Timestamp of parent message to reply in thread

tools.name: slack_set_status
tools.description: Sets the status of the authenticated user

status_expiration.description: Unix timestamp when status expires (0 for no expiration)
